text:
liam_h: hey folks, first week here — I can log into Console but the Flags -> Edit button is 403. who do I ask to get staging flag-admin access? need to unblock a quick PR.

tara_k: welcome! :wave: infra/ops handle the SSO group. for staging we use `redwood-console-staging-admins`. Did you file the access request in the onboarding form?

liam_h: filed yesterday (noah's checklist). still seeing 403. email is liam.h@redwood.com.

ops-bot: Access request received: ACC-5132. Approvers required: manager (tara_k) + infra. Estimated manual grant ~20m.

samira: small tip: Okta provisioning sometimes lags. Check SSO profile -> Groups to confirm membership. Also make sure you've enabled 2FA — infra rejects requests from accounts without MFA.

liam_h: 2FA is on. I don't see the staging-admins group yet.

ops-bot: Manual group add in progress by tara_k.

tara_k: adding you now. also if you need to run ffctl locally, request a scoped service account tagged `ffcli-temp`. we'll drop the key in the onboarding vault for 7 days.

liam_h: yes please — need a token to run the feature flag e2e locally. any preferred scopes?

tara_k: scope: flags.read, flags.write (staging only). no KMS unless you need secrets. path we'll use: `secret/onboarding/sa/liam-ffcli`.

ops-bot: Manual grant completed by tara_k. Group: redwood-console-staging-admins.

liam_h: confirmed — I can edit flags in staging now. thanks! also got the SA creds in the vault.

devex: awesome. if you want to add a tiny how-to to onboarding docs, drop commands like this:

```
# authenticate
ffctl auth login --service-account=/secrets/onboarding/sa/liam-ffcli.json
# list flags
ffctl flags list --env=staging
# set a flag
ffctl flags set --env=staging feature_x=true --comment "test rollout"
```

devex: we'll link it from the onboarding page.

liam_h: will open a small docs PR. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
